summary: The first-time experience is smooth overall, with clear controls and engaging progression through Comet Walls and Zig-Zag comets. The main friction is a ~2.2-second delay on both 'SHIP DOWN' fail screens before the 'TRY AGAIN' button or end card appears, leaving players with no clear action and unresponsive inputs.

items.title: Delayed 'TRY AGAIN' button on first fail screen
items.evidence: At t=21.7s, the 'SHIP DOWN' screen appeared with 'Score 60 · 1.78 km' but no button, causing the player's input to have no effect (S4) and only 23% clarity on what to do (S2) until 'TRY AGAIN' finally appeared at t=23.9s.
items.suggestion: Show the 'TRY AGAIN' button immediately when the 'SHIP DOWN' screen appears, or add a brief, visible countdown/transition indicator so players know not to tap yet.

items.title: Dead-air delay before end card on final fail screen
items.evidence: At t=39.3s, the 'SHIP DOWN' screen showed 'Out of ships' with no CTA, resulting in 26% clarity (S3) and an unresponsive input (S5) for 2.2 seconds until the end card appeared at t=41.5s.
items.suggestion: Transition directly to the end card or display a 'Loading...' / 'Final Score' progress indicator immediately on the 'Out of ships' screen.

items.title: Brief 2-second delay before first input registers
items.evidence: It took 2.0s from the first playable frame (tutorial overlay showing 'HOLD LEFT / RIGHT TO DODGE' and a hand pointing right) until an input visibly moved the rocket.
items.suggestion: Allow the player's first touch-and-hold to immediately dismiss the tutorial overlay and steer the rocket without any initial lock-out.
